description: SALT Deduction Cap 2018-2035 — State and local tax (SALT) deduction cap including the 2025-2029 increase: $40,000 (2025) / $40,400 (2026) rising 1% a year, phased down by 30% of MAGI over $500,000 / $505,000 to a $10,000 floor; $10,000 for 2018-2024 and 2030+; MFS half. Required: salt (state/local income or sales tax plus property tax paid, USD), magi (USD). Optional: year (default current), filing (single|mfj|hoh|mfs), standard_deduction and other_itemized (to get an ITEMIZE vs TAKE_STANDARD recommendation). Returns effective cap, deductible and disallowed SALT, phase-down details, verdict. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_salt_cap
